summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of AmbaShree Skills Academy site. Verified all critical flows and data-testids across desktop and mobile viewports. 31/31 checks passed. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form is client-side only (per user's explicit choice). Success toast shown but no data persisted - highlighted as MOCKED behavior in review request.
Placeholder phone/whatsapp (+91 00000 00000) and social links (#) are intentional placeholders per user's choice - main agent should replace when real info is provided.
Google Maps iframe uses a generic India query - update CONTACT.mapsQuery in /app/frontend/src/lib/data.js when actual address is available.
No backend endpoints were touched; default template's /api/status remains untested (not in scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 31 checks passed in one run: hero heading/subtitle text, nav scroll (Courses anchor), header Apply Now href=#contact, 10 course cards with all expected titles, 6 Why Choose Us cards with all expected titles, 3 Faculty cards (Shantanu Bhowmik, Ankita Chakrawarty, Anshuman) with credentials, 6 gallery items + Replace button interaction showing notice, testimonials next button + dot navigation, contact form empty validation (all 4 required errors), invalid-email validation, valid submission toast + form reset, contact map iframe, all 5 footer socials, floating WhatsApp button with wa.me href + target=_blank, hero WhatsApp CTA, Cormorant Garamond on h1, Outfit on body, no horizontal scroll at 390px mobile, mobile menu toggle opens drawer with nav links, hero CTAs visible on mobile.
